name: Alila Jabal Akhdar
insider_take: Perched 6,500 feet above sea level on Oman's dramatic Green Mountain, this clifftop sanctuary offers a rare mountain escape in the Arabian Peninsula.
whats_special: Built into the rocky landscape of Jebel Akhdar, Alila Jabal Akhdar is one of the highest resorts in the Middle East. The property showcases traditional Omani architecture with modern luxury, featuring stone-clad villas that blend seamlessly with the rugged terrain. The resort sits within the Al Hajar Mountains, where ancient falaj irrigation systems still water terraced rose gardens and pomegranate orchards.
pro_tip: Visit during rose harvesting season (April-May) when the mountain valleys are fragrant with Damask roses used to create Oman's famous rose water. The cooler mountain climate makes this the perfect summer escape from coastal heat.
dont_miss: The dramatic sunrise views from Diana's Point viewpoint, exploring the 2,000-year-old village of Al Ayn with its ancient beehive tombs, and hiking through the terraced gardens where locals still cultivate pomegranates using traditional methods. The resort's spa treatments using locally-sourced rose water and frankincense are equally unmissable.
pros: Spectacular mountain views from 2,000 meters elevation
Unique location in Oman's Green Mountain region
Award-winning spa with authentic wellness experiences
cons: Remote mountain location requires scenic but lengthy drive
Limited dining and entertainment options nearby
